maxillary_keypoint_topology.keypoint_spatial_matrix: Two distinct isolated spots on the upper-left maxillary region (subject's right), positioned approximately 2.5 spot-diameters above the first dense horizontal row, forming a roughly 20-degree upward angle relative to the horizontal plane of the lip.

rhinarium_pixel_ratio.melanin_saturation_percentage: Approximately 85-90% melanin coverage. High-density dark pixels dominate the lateral and superior surfaces of the rhinarium, with a small vertical patch of pink/pale pixels visible along the central philtrum area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Numerous dark punctate marks and irregular pigmentation spots are visible across the bridge of the nose and the maxillary area, but no definitive linear cicatrices or major tissue amputations are present.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced 'freckling' pattern (lentigines) on the light-colored fur of the muzzle, particularly concentrated between the vibrissae rows and the nasal bridge.
